1.s: Edom, proud in its mountain strongholds, will be brought down for standing by and gloating while Jerusalem was destroyed. “As you have done, it will be done to you.” But on Mount Zion there will be deliverance, “and the kingdom will be Yahweh’s.”
1.d: The shortest book in the Old Testament [[tbd:002:Book of Obadiah]]. Using the name Esau shows that Edom broke a brotherly bond with Jacob [[tosn:Obadiah 1:6]] [[tosn:Obadiah 1:10–14]]. Edom celebrated Judah’s fall, took its goods and handed over refugees to Babylon [[tbd:002:Book of Obadiah]]; Psalm 137:7 also remembers Edom on that day [[bible:Psalm 137:7]].
